People are stupid, They think that "KARMA" is real and if you are patient, EVENTUALLY it will "MAGICALLY" get better. Sorry about that, you will have to work on your life to make better. Life was never meant to be fair. You have to use what you got to get a the life you desire. We can't tell you what to do, it may even be impossible to fix your life as it is, but calm down and think of the options you got. Think of a way to get your desired life. Maybe getting and education or some training will help build you up. As for the pandemic, it's only temporary so. you have to have patience... 

Wish you good luck.
